author: Red_Panda48
body:
Petrify is easily the worse status in game imo. Fortunately there are several ways to prevent or remove it available to you right now.

For prevention, you'll want to pick up a stone pendant (dropped by the regular cockatrice boss). It takes up an accessory slot, but it will also prevent petrify which is a good tradeoff in many situations imo.

As for removing petrify there are a few options. The most common solution is to use a panacea, however those are a bit rare at that tier so you may not want to waste them every time you get petrified. Another solution is less rare but more expensive, and that is to craft Nostrums from herbalists. They can remove most statuses, but cost herbs which may be semi-difficult to get without doing a ton of gauntlets. Lastly, use a pet with dispel. Normally this wouldn't be an option for anyone under T8, but with this current event comes the t4 Alfar pet that knows it and only costs 250k gold. 

When you hit T8 you'll be able to get cockatrice armor which has built in petrify protection and pretty solid protective stats, however until then you kinda have to suffer through with less convenient methods of dealing with it.

author: Grikonen
body:
**Quick overview:**

\- nostrum (potion) (T4) - (removes petri and others) made at the herbalist.

\- panacea (potion) (T4) - (removes petri and others + full heal) rarer and harder to make; drops more commonly at T8.

\- stone pendant (T6) - (immunity to petri) pretty sure you can find it via PvP drops; otherwise drops from Cockatrice (appears on world map T7 onwards or dungeon T8 onwards).

Later on....

\- llamrai (pet; event only) (T6) - (can dispel petri and others) he was last seen June 2021 but will most likely rotate during the next Avalon event.

\- cockatrice mail (T8) - (immunity to petri) drops from Great Cockatrice.

\- avalon crown (T8) - (immunity petri + curse) drops from Fallen King Arthus.

\- pale dragon (pet) (T8) - (dispels petri and others)

\- aegis (T9) - (immunity to petri).

\- polished aegis (T10) - (immunity to petri).

But also: if you are really having trouble with statuses cast on yourself at the lower levels, remember you can do the same to most enemies. Enemies at the lower tiers have very few (if any) immunities to statuses. Gargoyles, Carmans and other witches can be: frozen, put to sleep, blinded etc. It costs practically nothing to unlock sleep/blind/stun skills from the earlier thief classes.

author: Rufzeichen
body:
had a fight with carman of the underworld, where the first petrify lasted 12 rounds (yes i counted), then missed my attack and got re-petrified for another 4 rounds, while carman did 0 damage because of high res. it felt like being softlocked.  
i guess its only fair since i like to stack status effects on bosses to defeat those that have had 50 levels on me. they had their revenge now, and bosses at tier 8 start to have multiple status resistances
